articles.title: Smart Speaker Wi-Fi setup
steps: Hold the reset button for 5 seconds until the light blinks.
Open the app and choose Settings > Devices > Add New.
Select your 2.4 GHz network and enter the password.

articles.title: Headphones crackling or dropping audio
steps: Remove the headphones from your device's Bluetooth list and pair again.
Move away from other wireless devices and test again.

articles.title: Laptop stand wobbles
steps: Tighten both hinge screws with the included key.
Check that the rubber feet are attached and clean.
